text:
marta: bringing up mastiff15b-int4 on canary — seeing intermittent OOMs under spiky traffic and a small drop in long-form coherence vs our fp16 baseline. anyone else noticing this?
rajiv: yep. pattern is OOMs when max_new_tokens >= 250 or when batch_size > 1. my hypothesis: int4 kernel allocation granularity + kv-cache fragmentation making large contiguous allocs fail.
aline: stack from a failed run:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA OOM when allocating tensor of size 1.05 GiB (GPU 0; 48.00 GiB total capacity; 40.90 GiB already allocated)
  at runtime/kv_cache.cc:378
  kv_cache stats: reserved 6.0 GiB, active 28.9 GiB, free_fragments: 2.1 GiB
```
devon: quick mitigation to try before heavier fixes: lower defaults and enable trimming. propose: default_batch_size: 1, default_max_new_tokens: 140, prefetch_window: 12, kv_trim_on_evict: true. config patch:
```yaml
models:
  mastiff15b-int4:
    default_batch_size: 1
    default_max_new_tokens: 140
    prefetch_window: 12
    kv_trim_on_evict: true
    adaptive_batching: {min:1, max:2, pad_to:8}
```
marta: rolling that to canary-3 now and kicking off regen tests vs fp16 eval set.
rajiv: while it's running, collect allocator/kv profiles: `servectl profile --model mastiff15b-int4 --metric slab,kv,alloc` during mixed load. should give fragmentation heatmap.
sylvia: ran a 50-request smoke with the patched defaults — no OOMs and peak memory dropped ~5.8 GiB. downside: PPL +1.9% on long prompts and mild increase in hallucination on multi-step tool workflows.
aline: sounds like the expected int4 tradeoff. next step: try per-channel quant calibration + bump kv_cushion to 0.14 and enable slab_defrag during off-peak. that often recovers logits without going full fp16.
devon: sample runtime patch to try:
```json
{"quant": {"mode": "int4_per_channel", "calibrate_steps": 2048}, "kv": {"cushion": 0.14}, "memory": {"slab_defrag_window": "03:00-04:00"}}
```
marta: starting calibration job and scheduling slab defrag in the next maintenance window. also updating route rule: if request.meta.tool_calls > 0 -> route to mastiff15b-int4-dedicated (bigger kv cushion). will also temporarily expose customer_max_new_tokens=160 in docs while we tune.
oncall-bot: deploy roll started: mastiff15b-int4 -> canary-3; CI smoke queued.
rajiv: add telemetry for max_new_tokens tails: emit percentile(90,99) and fraction >180 tokens per minute. also alert if tool_call sessions > 90th percentile of kv growth.
sylvia: FYI the OOMs we saw were almost all from sessions that did heavy function-calling; kv growth is sustained across turns. routing tool sessions to dedicated pods should be high ROI.
marta: follow-ups: 1) run per-channel calibration + eval suite 2) monitor slab/kv fragmentation and tail token telemetry 3) enable defrag on low-traffic window 4) prepare hybrid build (fp16 attention, int4 weights) if quality doesn't recover. assigning rajiv/sylvia.
marta: will post results when the canary finishes. :thumbsup:
